en.title: Minimum Total Quote to Complete All Projects
en.description:
Choose one quote for each project and find the minimum total price to complete all projects; if any project has no quote, return −1. Quotes do not constrain one another.

This site independently prepared the standard I/O and the solution; supplements for bounds missing from the source and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the protocol.
en.input: The first line contains the number of projects p and the number of quotes n, followed by n lines, each with a project ID and a quote. The original full bounds are 1≤p,n<500000, and project IDs are 0..p−1 as in the original example. The original range of quote values is missing; this site adds −10^9..10^9. Output the exact integer.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 21; -1; -2. Verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Keep the minimum quote for each project, then check that every project is covered and add them up.
